name: arrays-of-arrays-test-253b35e6d5/arrays-of-arrays-v.bal
spec_references: Expressions > Literal: Currently support `nil-literal`, `boolean-literal`, `numeric-literal` and `string-literal` only
reason: testByteArrayIterator uses the byte-array literal base16 `aa`, which is not covered by the supported expression/literal list. This is essential to the asserted byte output 170, so the whole case requires an unsupported feature.
test_design_notes: The @output 170 assertion depends on constructing and retrieving the byte supplied by the unsupported literal; io:println is only instrumentation.
